_about: Failure-reason glossary for the mock messaging provider. All wording is invented for this project. To use a real provider, replace the 'reasons' list with that provider's own documented reasons (keep the same keys). A reason that is not listed is reported as 'not documented' and is never guessed.

recipient_number.label: Recipient number
recipient_number.who_fixes: Usually nothing to fix on the sending side; the number is invalid, inactive or restricted. If many numbers are malformed, check how our system builds the number.

recipient_device.label: Recipient device
recipient_device.who_fixes: Usually nothing to fix on the sending side; the phone is off, full or out of coverage.

network.label: Network
network.who_fixes: Usually nothing to fix on the sending side; a temporary operator or network problem. Persistent cases go to the provider.

sending_pattern.label: Our sending pattern or content
sending_pattern.who_fixes: Ours to check; how often or how we send, or what the message says.

opt_out.label: Opt-out preference
opt_out.who_fixes: The recipient's own preference; if it hits verification codes, check the message category registered with the provider.

registration.label: Registration
registration.who_fixes: Ours to fix; a template or sender registration problem with the provider.

unknown.label: Not documented
unknown.who_fixes: Not in the glossary; ask the provider what it means and add it to data/reason_glossary.json.

reasons.label: Recipient unreachable
reasons.meaning: The provider could not reach the recipient's phone (switched off, no coverage or full inbox).

reasons.label: Recipient opted out
reasons.meaning: The recipient has chosen not to receive messages of this kind.

reasons.label: Message expired
reasons.meaning: The message waited too long for delivery and the provider dropped it.

reasons.label: Invalid recipient format
reasons.meaning: The number sent to the provider is not a valid full number (for example a missing country prefix).

reasons.label: Template not registered
reasons.meaning: The message text does not match any registered template.

reasons.label: Sender not registered
reasons.meaning: The sender name is not registered for this account.

reasons.label: Network failure
reasons.meaning: The operator network did not accept or confirm the message in time.

reasons.label: Rate limited
reasons.meaning: Too many messages were sent to the same recipient in a short time.

E101.label: Insufficient credit
E101.meaning: The account had no credit, so the request was refused before it was submitted to the provider.

E102.label: Sender not allowed
E102.meaning: The sender name used is not allowed for this account.

E103.label: Template missing
E103.meaning: The template named in the request does not exist.

E110.label: Duplicate within 20 seconds
E110.meaning: The same request was received twice within 20 seconds and the second was dropped. Normal on its own.

E105.label: Invalid recipient format
E105.meaning: The number in the request was not a valid full number, so it was refused before submission.
